description: Codex: Orks (11e) BREAKIN' HEADS (War Horde, 1 CP, either player's turn, any phase) through the real unit_battle_shocked window (design §3). Fixture ork11e_orks_active: P1 Orks (War Horde) active in the Command phase; Boyz B is an Attached unit (Warboss A leads it). Setup privileges: 6 Boyz are removed (below half-strength, so the unit must make a battle-shock roll) and the Boyz' + Warboss' Leadership is set to 13 so the roll cannot pass; P1 has 4 CP. The player resolves the roll through the real roll call (panel button -> Roll; the Command Re-roll offer, if any, is answered with Keep). The failed roll makes the Attached unit battle-shocked, which opens the unit_battle_shocked window for its owner: the StratagemDialog offers BREAKIN' HEADS on the battle-shocked unit (targetable although battle-shocked) with an enabled Use button. A real click on Use spends 1 CP, rolls one D3 — the unit suffers that many mortal wounds — and the Boyz and the Warboss are no longer battle-shocked. The roll-call card that showed the failed test is refreshed after the stratagem (WH-7): its verdict reads BREAKIN' HEADS — NO LONGER BATTLE-SHOCKED with the D3 mortal wounds.

steps.script:
var boyz = GameState.state["units"]["U_BOYZ_B"]
for i in range(6):
	boyz["models"][i]["alive"] = false
	boyz["models"][i]["current_wounds"] = 0
boyz["meta"]["stats"]["leadership"] = 13
GameState.state["units"]["U_WARBOSS_A"]["meta"]["stats"]["leadership"] = 13
GameState.state["players"]["1"]["cp"] = 4
SceneRefs.main()._recreate_unit_visuals()
var cp = PhaseManager.get_current_phase_instance()
cp._units_tested.clear()
cp._identify_units_needing_tests()
return cp._units_needing_test.has("U_BOYZ_B")

steps.comment: a real player answers the start-of-phase prompts (secondary-mission review, ...) first — they are exclusive windows
Command Re-roll offer (not under test): keep the failed roll
the phase waits for the decision
WH-7: the roll-call card that showed the failed test is still open under the window
WH-7: the card is refreshed — it no longer says BATTLE-SHOCKED after the stratagem cleared it
D3 mortal wounds on the 4 remaining W1 Boyz (bodyguard first): alive Boyz = 4 - D3
